tools.name: search_oneway_flights
tools.title: FlightPowers: search one-way flights
tools.summary: FlightPowers one-way fare search: live prices read from Google Flights.

parameters.name: from_airport
parameters.about: Origin IATA code, e.g. "TLV". One origin per search; a second one is refused rather than searched.

parameters.name: to_airport
parameters.about: Destination airport. One IATA code ("BCN"), several separated by commas ("BCN,LIS,ATH"), or a list (["BCN","LIS","ATH"]) -- every shape is accepted and the destinations are compared in the same search.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.about: Single departure date, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: departure_date_from
parameters.about: First date of a departure range.

parameters.name: departure_date_to
parameters.about: Last date of a departure range.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.about: Maximum stops per flight. 0 means non-stop only.

parameters.name: airline_codes
parameters.about: Restrict to these airline codes, e.g. ["LY"].

parameters.name: exclude_airline_codes
parameters.about: Exclude these airline codes.

parameters.name: departure_time_min
parameters.about: Earliest departure hour, 0-23.

parameters.name: departure_time_max
parameters.about: Latest departure hour, 0-23.

parameters.name: arrival_time_min
parameters.about: Earliest arrival hour, 0-23.

parameters.name: arrival_time_max
parameters.about: Latest arrival hour, 0-23.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code, default "usd".

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.about: Only return flights at or below this price.

parameters.name: seat_type
parameters.about: 1 economy, 2 premium economy, 3 business, 4 first.

parameters.name: passengers
parameters.about: One entry per traveller, not a count: 1 adult, 2 child (aged 2-11), 3 infant on lap, 4 infant in seat, e.g. [1, 1, 2] for two adults and a child.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.about: "best", "price", or "duration". Applied across all results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.about: Maximum flights to return, after merging and sorting.

parameters.name: max_searches
parameters.about: The billed requests this call may make, up or down.

parameters.name: use_fallback
parameters.about: Leave unset. Switches the search to a second, independent flight data source instead of the usual Google Flights page read.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.about: Return every field the upstream sends on each fare, and every fare that was selected, with no row bound.

tools.name: search_roundtrip_flights
tools.title: FlightPowers: search round-trip flights
tools.summary: FlightPowers round-trip fare search: live prices read from Google Flights, priced as paired legs rather than two separate one-ways.

parameters.name: from_airport
parameters.about: Origin IATA code, e.g. "TLV". One origin per search; a second one is refused rather than searched.

parameters.name: to_airport
parameters.about: Destination airport. One IATA code ("BCN"), several separated by commas ("BCN,LIS,ATH"), or a list (["BCN","LIS","ATH"]) -- every shape is accepted and the destinations are compared in the same search.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.about: Single outbound date, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: departure_date_from
parameters.about: First date of an outbound range.

parameters.name: departure_date_to
parameters.about: Last date of an outbound range.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.about: Fixed return date. Use this OR nights, not both.

parameters.name: nights
parameters.about: Trip length in nights; a number, or a list like [5, 6, 7].

parameters.name: max_departure_stops
parameters.about: Maximum stops on the outbound leg.

parameters.name: max_return_stops
parameters.about: Maximum stops on the return leg.

parameters.name: departure_airline_codes
parameters.about: Restrict the outbound leg to these airlines.

parameters.name: return_airline_codes
parameters.about: Restrict the return leg to these airlines.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code, default "usd".

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.about: Only return trips at or below this total price.

parameters.name: seat_type
parameters.about: 1 economy, 2 premium economy, 3 business, 4 first.

parameters.name: passengers
parameters.about: One entry per traveller, not a count: 1 adult, 2 child (aged 2-11), 3 infant on lap, 4 infant in seat, e.g. [1, 1, 2] for two adults and a child.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.about: "best", "price", or "duration". Applied across all results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.about: Maximum trips to return, after merging and sorting.

parameters.name: max_searches
parameters.about: The billed requests this call may make, up or down.

parameters.name: use_fallback
parameters.about: Leave unset. Switches the search to a second, independent flight data source instead of the usual Google Flights page read.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.about: Return every field the upstream sends on each fare, and every fare that was selected, with no row bound.
